newsitem.title: UK: LME copper probes resistance in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper probes resistance in late trading.

text.p: LME copper edged higher to probe $2,280 per tonne resistance in late inter-office trading on Friday after slumping towards the day's lows on the kerb.
At 1800 GMT, three month copper was indicated at $2,278/83, up from a kerb close of $2,269.
After being wounded by heavy fund selling this week, many in the market were preparing for weaker prices on Monday, with support pegged at $2,250 and $2,200.
The other metals were little changed.
